action.name: replaceWith
action.tooltip: Replaces this node with the given node

action.name: replaceWith
action.tooltip: Overload which accepts a list of join points

action.name: detach
action.tooltip: Removes node associated to the joinpoint from the AST

action.name: insertBefore
action.tooltip: Inserts the given join point before this join point

action.name: insertAfter
action.tooltip: Inserts the given join point after this join point

action.name: copy
action.tooltip: Performs a copy of the node and its children, but not of the nodes in its fields

action.name: deepCopy
action.tooltip: Performs a copy of the node and its children, including the nodes in their fields (only the first level of field nodes, this function is not recursive)

action.name: setLeft
action.tooltip: Sets the left-hand side of the operation

action.name: setRight
action.tooltip: Sets the right-hand side of the operation

action.name: addUseStmt
action.tooltip: Adds a UseStmt to a specification part. The statement is inserted at the beginning.

action.name: copyScope
action.tooltip: Performs a copy of the do statement, including its controls, but not the body
